faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 20th September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. in specific engineering fields or an M.Sc. in Electronics, Computer Science, or Physics, with at least 60% marks or an equivalent CGPA from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA (House Rent Allowance).

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their application along with required documents to the official email address provided by BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani).

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates with GATE/NET qualification preferred?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who hold a valid GATE/NET qualification will be preferred for the Junior Research Fellow position, if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.
